steps.en: Officer revives a suspension or reduction in the OCMS staff portal
steps.id: Officer me-revive suspension atau reduction di staff portal OCMS

steps.en: Officer revives a suspension or reduction through PLUS
steps.id: Officer me-revive suspension atau reduction lewat PLUS

steps.en: The revival is recorded with date, reason and officer
steps.id: Revival dicatat lengkap dengan tanggal, alasan, dan officer

steps.en: The notice is no longer marked as suspended
A revived reduction puts the amount payable back to the full amount
steps.id: Reduction yang di-revive mengembalikan jumlah bayar ke jumlah penuh
steps.why_en: If the reduction record is missing, the amount stays reduced and the revival still reports success.
steps.why_id: Kalau record reduction hilang, jumlahnya tetap berkurang dan revival tetap dilaporkan sukses.

steps.en: The notice goes back into the normal automated processing
steps.id: Notice kembali masuk ke pemrosesan otomatis yang normal
steps.why_en: Processing resumes only through later scheduled jobs; only some were checked and the workflow document is not in the repo.
steps.why_id: Pemrosesan lanjut hanya lewat job terjadwal berikutnya; baru sebagian dicek dan dokumen workflow tidak ada di repo.
